title: A view's own parameters and fields override every view it extends
rule: The extending view's own declarations win over every extended view, merged parameter by parameter.

citations.quote: If there are any conflicts, the extending object will take precedence and override the settings of the object that is being extended.
any explicitly written LookML gets merged
the version in the extending object is used

rationale: The documentation's implementation example merges a status dimension from both views: it keeps sql from the extended view and takes type from the extending view.
